name: boj_get_policy_rate
description:
Bank of Japan short-term rates in percent from FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis): call_money is the overnight call money rate (IRSTCI01JPM156N, monthly), discount the basic discount/loan rate (INTDSRJPM193N).
Returns: series_code (FRED id), series_id, label, source, observation_count and observations (date, value) oldest first, missing values dropped.
Inputs (* required): rate_type* (call_money or discount; schema default call_money); start_date, end_date (YYYY-MM-DD); recent_periods (1-100; the last N observations, with no dates looking back N x 45 days; when omitted the whole history in the date range is returned).
For JGB yields use boj_get_jgb_yield; all series: boj_list_series. Needs a FRED API key (FRED_API_KEY, config fred.api.key); without one the call fails with a message saying so.
Example: {"rate_type": "call_money", "recent_periods": 24}

rate_type.description: Policy rate series: call_money (uncollateralized overnight call rate) or discount (basic discount/loan rate)
